professional_advances: Proxy Inspector for request/response headers, cookies, CORS, cache, security headers and timing
Proxy redacted HAR 1.2 export with sensitive-header masking and binary Base64 content
Proxy validated multi-address DNS pinning with fallback only inside the already-approved address set
Rules/AutoResponder local responses remain upstream-free and bounded
Enterprise bounded batch lease API and bounded concurrent Worker execution path
Enterprise liveness and readiness endpoints with readiness fail-closed on queue invariant violations
Extraction Studio remains an independent professional collection workbench
Packet Intelligence and MITM interception remain independent professional workbenches
server_hardening: Modern Enterprise Server and Coordinator default to TLS 1.3
TLS 1.2 is explicit compatibility opt-in for Server/Worker; Coordinator remains TLS 1.3-only
Uvicorn in-flight concurrency, backlog, keep-alive and graceful shutdown are explicitly bounded
Rate limiter high-cardinality churn cannot evict a known peer and reset its rate history
Proxy remote exposure blocks private/loopback/link-local targets by default
Enterprise health exposes bounded traffic and rate-limiter state without high-cardinality labels
SQLite deployment profile is explicitly single-host; PostgreSQL is the multi-host server backend

performance_interpretation.sqlite_queue: All 1/2/4/8/16/32 Worker levels were stable with zero errors/invariant/thread/FD leaks. Peak execute throughput in this run was 84.994 jobs/s, but tail latency rose materially at 16/32 Workers; use PostgreSQL for sustained high-concurrency or multi-host deployment.
performance_interpretation.http_tls: All tested 1/4/8/16/32 client levels were stable and negotiated TLSv1.3. Peak loopback health throughput was 1012.678 req/s at the measured optimum; this is a lightweight health-endpoint microbenchmark, not an application workload SLA.
